contracts.contract: Top-level model dispatch is background; nested dispatch is inline. Rust intentionally preserves opt-in explicit background=true.
Accepted background work returns mode background, status dispatched, delegation_id and subagent_ids.
Default batching reports one whole call; independent group completion is optional and not implemented in this increment.

additional_source: tools/AGENTS.md:175-182 describes detached turn-stop survival and explicit /stop/reset cancellation
rust_extensions: Durable immutable admission handle and completion record
Restart records interrupted/uncertain outcomes, never replays effects
Bounded explicit rejection instead of inline fallback on capacity exhaustion
